summary: BBB Foods Inc. filed a Form 6-K containing its 2Q26 earnings release, reporting quarterly financial results and operational highlights. The filing includes total revenue of Ps. 26,037 million, 38.7% growth, same-store sales up 20.0%, EBITDA of Ps. 960 million, and 155 net new stores opened. It references a May 2026 equity follow-on offering but does not announce a special situation. This is a routine earnings report by a foreign private issuer, not a merger, tender, activism, or other corporate event. No deal terms, premiums, or board actions are present.
